Creates a Presentation Request. The body names the credentials, and the attributes of them, that the holder is asked to present. An entry that omits `attributes` asks for every attribute the schema defines. With a `connectionId` the agent sends the request on that connection and answers with neither `invitation` nor `shortUrl`; without one it mints an Out-of-Band invitation.
